scripts.dev:pretty: bash -lc 'if command -v pino-pretty >/dev/null 2>&1; then next dev --turbopack | pino-pretty; else echo "[dev:pretty] pino-pretty 未安装，回退到原始日志输出" >&2; next dev --turbopack; fi'
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true })" && next build
scripts.build:cf: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true })" && node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/build-cf.mjs
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:cf && wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static
scripts.db:migrate:local:prod: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-migrate-safe.mjs --database DB --local --env production
scripts.db:migrate:remote:prod: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-migrate-safe.mjs --database DB --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local:preview: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-migrate-safe.mjs --database DB --local --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:remote:preview: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-migrate-safe.mjs --database DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:status:remote:prod: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-release-status.mjs --database DB --remote --env production
scripts.db:status:remote:prod:ready: node scripts/check-wrangler-d1-config.mjs && node scripts/d1-release-status.mjs --database DB --remote --env production --require-ready
